english.description: Unlabeled, half full or half empty?
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_MedicineBottle

english.description: Its seams are loose from years of small hands clinging tight. It remembers lullabies no one else does.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Ragdoll

english.description: Bent by time, stained by ash, still it demands reverence.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_QueenCrown

english.description: Whispering truths of the stars in an older language.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Codex

english.description: Long lost its value as a currency, yet this amount of gold could weight on anyone's shoulders.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_GoldCoins

english.description: Heavy with history, soft to the touch like melted time.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_GoldNugget

english.description: Still warm, as if recently removed from a wrist that won't decay.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Bracelet

english.description: It hums with a warmth not of this world, like a heartbeat echoing through the stone beneath your feet.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Amulet

english.description: Worn smooth by a thousand fearful hands.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_SmallStatue

english.description: Hung with teeth and thread, it protects but not for free.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Talisman

english.description: Doesn't deal much damage, yet its blade cuts through flesh and spirit.
english.name: ITEM_Weapon_Dagger

english.description: Its wail echoes like laughter lost in stone halls, part cry, part call.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Cuica

english.description: It pulses faintly, as if waiting to hatch something you may regret.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_CrystalEgg

english.description: It casts no light on lies, only on what you dared not see.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Lantern

english.description: A crystal shaped bean, as if still growing
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_BeanGem

english.description: Golden veins run through it, whispering of harvests long old
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_CornGem

english.description: Pulse with warmth, like sunlight trapped in glass
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_TomatoGem

english.description: A deep crimson eye, awake, alert, watching
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_GuaranaGem

english.description: It dreams in silence, yearning for soil that no longer lives.
english.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Seed

english.description: The treasure is you, not what you take.

schinese.description: 尺寸跟任何手指都不合，然而一旦戴上，便再也脱不下来。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_DiamondRing

schinese.description: 身子在地牢的穹顶下深埋已久，但其空洞的眼瞳依然留恋天空。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_BirdStatue

schinese.description: 如鲜血般温暖，又如背叛般冰冷。戴久了，便会慢慢收紧桎梏。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_RubyNecklace

schinese.description: 瓶身没有标签，里面还剩半瓶药……还是说没了半瓶？
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_MedicineBottle

schinese.description: 被小手紧握多年，缝线已经绽开，但还记得他人遗忘了的摇篮曲。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Ragdoll

schinese.description: 历经岁月磨砺，染上了斑驳灰烬，却依然让人心生敬畏。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_QueenCrown

schinese.description: 用古老的语言低声细诉群星的真理。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Codex

schinese.description: 早已失去货币的价值，但这等分量的黄金足以蛊惑人心。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_GoldCoins

schinese.description: 厚重的历史，温润的触感，犹如将时间凝成此物。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_GoldNugget

schinese.description: 依然温热，仿佛刚从永不腐朽的手腕上取下来。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Bracelet

schinese.description: 这护符散发着与这个世界格格不入的暖意与脉动，令你脚下的石头也为之颤动。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Amulet

schinese.description: 成千上万双又敬又畏的手，将此物磨得光滑无比。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_SmallStatue

schinese.description: 将成排牙齿用线穿成，虽能消灾解难，但要为此付出代价。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Talisman

schinese.description: 造成的伤害虽然不高，但还是足以割破肉体，甚至刺伤灵魂。
schinese.name: ITEM_Weapon_Dagger

schinese.description: 它的哀鸣在四周回荡，如同迷失在石厅中的笑声，既是啼哭，亦是呼唤。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Cuica

schinese.description: 微弱地搏动着，仿佛会孵出令你追悔莫及的物事。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_CrystalEgg

schinese.description: 无法揭穿谎言，只能映照出你不敢面对之物。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Lantern

schinese.description: 水晶状的豆子，仿佛还在生长。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_BeanGem

schinese.description: 流淌着金色的血脉，轻诉着不复存在的丰收岁月。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_CornGem

schinese.description: 散发出阵阵暖意，如同困在玻璃中的阳光。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_TomatoGem

schinese.description: 猩红深邃的眼眸，清醒且警惕地凝视着你。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_GuaranaGem

schinese.description: 无声地做着美梦，渴望那不复存在的土壤。
schinese.name: ITEM_UNIQUE_Seed

schinese.description: 真正的宝藏是你，而不是你所获取的东西。
schinese.name: WHITE_ENDING
